rendering_invariants: Every page must have an explicitly defined route and a unique page_id.
All HTML outputs must have the <!DOCTYPE html> declaration and an <html> root.
Every page must have a skip-link and a <main> landmark with id="main".
Generated HTML must have relative links only, with no absolute hostname prefixes.
All text injected from artifacts must be HTML-escaped or sanitized.
deterministic_ordering_rules: Page generation order is sorted alphabetically by page_id.
Navigation items are sorted alphabetically by page_id.
Dynamic tables/lists from JSONL files are ordered by their primary keys or timestamps.
navigation_index_expectations: A site index file (index.html) must be generated with links to all valid routes.
A navigation manifest (site_manifest.v1.json) must be generated containing the list of route metadata.
cross_link_behavior: Internal cross-links must resolve correctly using relative paths.
No absolute URLs pointing to localhost or hardcoded repositories are allowed in internal links.
schema_validation_requirements: The input manifest must be validated against rig.site.input_manifest.v1 schema before processing.
Each page model must be validated against rig.site.page.v1 schema before processing.
Each source JSON artifact must be validated against its declared schema if schema_path is present.
output_artifact_requirements: A render report must be generated validating against rig.site.render_report.v1 schema.
failure_refusal_behavior: If an artifact is invalid or unsafe, a failure verdict must be recorded in the page's status.
The error must be logged and written to the render report under pages with status: failed.
No HTML page is rendered for a critical validation failure, or a refusal page is output instead.
fake_green_risks: Fake green occurs when invalid schemas or missing files are treated as warnings and return exit code 0.
Fake green occurs when tests run on mock/synthetic data only, failing to catch real-world syntax changes.
